mapper.select: SELECT rt.room_type_id, rt.tenant_id, rt.dept_id, rt.type_name, rt.type_code, rt.description, rt.standard_occupancy, rt.max_occupancy, rt.room_area, rt.bed_configuration, rt.amenities, rt.default_price, rt.status, rt.sort_order, rt.images, rt.create_dept, rt.create_by, rt.create_time, rt.update_by, rt.update_time, d.dept_name FROM pms_room_types rt LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON rt.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE rt.room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND rt.del_flag = '0'

SELECT room_type_id, type_name, type_code, status, default_price, standard_occupancy, max_occupancy FROM pms_room_types WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND status = 'active' AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, room_type_id ASC
